llm_judge_details.justification: The core includes most mandatory VNFs but omits PCF/NEF and any RAN elements, limiting completeness. VNF types and inter‑connections follow 3GPP specs, though some optional links are absent, yielding good correctness. Resource requests are modest; for a campus of 2000 users with video streaming they may be marginal, so appropriateness is moderate. The single eMBB slice (SST=1) matches the intended use cases, giving full alignment. SLA latency of 10 ms is aggressive for end‑to‑end campus service, while throughput and availability are reasonable, resulting in a mixed SLA fitness.
